text:
sam_sales: Heads-up team, AcuMed POC is ready to sign the order form but legal wants clarity on sub-processors and they changed Net terms to Net30. Procurement wants the DocuSign flow to go our legal -> billing -> their AP. Can we confirm what we can accept quickly?

nina_legal: We can accept Net30 for first PO if finance approves cashflow hit. On sub-processors: offer current list as Appendix B + 30-day notice for additions. Add a 14-day cure window for objections.

raj_engineering: From product: we can't expose detailed HSM topology, but can confirm KMS options. Suggested blurb: "Hosted: Redwood-managed KMS (AES-256). Private: support for customer-managed KMS/HSM with BYOK."

kate_finance: Net30 is okay once sales adds an acknowledgement of invoice delivery method and PO number. For DocuSign: set Billing_CC to billing@redwood.com and make AP routing step configurable to their ap@acumed.com.

esign-bot: Template `rwd-order-v3` supports routing: 1) Redwood Legal (signature), 2) Billing (cc), 3) Customer Exec (signature), 4) Customer AP (signature). Can set envelope to auto-complete on final signature. Provide emails and PO.

sam_sales: They also requested uptime penalty language. We should avoid direct penalties; propose service credits up to 50% monthly fee for downtime. Nina, can you add that to the order form?

nina_legal: Will add standard service credit clause and cap at 50% of monthly fees. Also will add the Appendix B placeholder for sub-processors.

raj_engineering: Also propose a non-binding per-route latency appendix for the POC: chat p95 < 150ms (us-west), embeddings p95 < 250ms (eu). Mark it as "operational profile" not a contractual SLA.

sam_sales: Action list: Nina to draft Appendix B + service credit text, Raj to paste KMS blurb and p95 table into appendix, Kate to confirm billing email and approve Net30, I'll collect signatory emails and send template.

kate_finance: I approve Net30 for this POC. I'll send billing@redwood.com and PO once customer confirms.

nina_legal: Drafting Appendix B now, will post redline by EOD PST.

esign-bot: Once signatories listed, I will create envelope and link. Remember to attach Appendix B to the DocuSign packet.

sam_sales: Thanks all, I'll message AcuMed to expect updated envelope tomorrow. :thumbsup:
